data.title: 玛露希尔 · 海湾野餐的安全料理
data.description: 【迷宫外海湾·午后】玛露希尔穿着蓝色泳装外搭浅色长袍，坐在岩石旁给海滨野餐做最后的魔法加热；她先对一盘看起来可疑的食物皱眉，再把安全的蘑菇料理递向镜头，绿瞳里满是“这次真的能吃”的自信。
data.action: 海湾岩石旁用小魔法加热料理，挑掉可疑食材后把安全成品递向镜头
data.lighting: warm afternoon sun over sea and picnic cloth
data.mood: 把冒险料理变成安心海滨午餐
data.promptProse: Marcille Donato warms the seaside picnic's mushroom dish with a tiny controlled spell, frowning at a suspicious ingredient before setting it aside and presenting the finished plate toward the viewer. Her blue swimsuit, cream travel robe and sunhat remain clear beside the food basket. The horizontal medium view includes coastal rocks and the picnic cloth. Warm afternoon sun lights the plate and blonde braids, with broad rock shadows and faint local spell reflections beneath her hand.
